He has short dark hair and a slight smile. The bride is in the center-right, wearing a white strapless wedding dress and veil, looking down with a gentle expression. A third person's arm and hand are visible on the far right, adjusting the bride's hair or veil. The background includes a window, some hanging decorations (possibly red lanterns or ornaments), and indoor lighting.
